name: Streaming Auditing Governance Concentration Beyond Token Allocation A Live Governance Stud C60D87Ba73
text: Auditing governance concentration beyond token allocation states that launch allocation, raw holder counts, and token-inequality metrics do not establish token-governance decentralization. This adds a live-control audit qualification to Kaal's claim that governance concentrated in a handful of foundation actors fails to produce decentralized governance. The proposition does not show that any single metric or launch structure determines legitimacy.
